_comment: Google rating snapshot and review excerpts. Excerpts are verbatim from real Google reviewers (trimmed only with '...'). Do not edit wording. Only items with approved: true render in production; preview builds show all with a 'Pending approval' tag. Do NOT add AggregateRating/Review schema for these.

excerpts.author: Cassidy Driskell
excerpts.text: Everyone was so kind and it was such a nice family atmosphere... We ordered the Guatemalan Tamales and they are our new favorite.

excerpts.author: Shannon
excerpts.text: It’s very warm and inviting and intimate... The staff was very friendly and the food was delicious. The pricing was also very reasonable.

excerpts.author: Google reviewer
excerpts.text: Every thing we ordered was cooked perfectly and not salty or greasy.

excerpts.author: Google reviewer
excerpts.text: I highly recommend their lamb ribs and the chicken tostada, really yummy 😋

alternates.author: Hristu Chepa
alternates.text: This place was amazing. I got the birria pizza and it was perfectly done.
alternates.note: Use only if birria pizza is confirmed as a current menu item.
